research_question: Does candidate scoring fail closed when a scored/native-current table lacks its checked source log, and does it reject summaries that conflict with source-level evidence while preserving the all-NA transcript-context diagnostic?
hypothesis: Requiring joint candidate-table/search-log validation at the scorer boundary prevents stale or unsupported summary fields from producing target-specific rankings, while an all-NA non-current transcript handoff remains an unranked diagnostic.
preparation: Reanalysis of a curated 15-candidate evidence table and its 19-record source log, with a separate GSE157504 transcript-only all-NA diagnostic; no new biological measurements.
cell_type: Independent target runs for s-LNv, l-LNv, LNd and DN.
experimental_unit: Curated source-level evidence record; no animal-level or biological-replicate inference.
primary_readout: Fail-closed behavior of candidate scoring for membrane_potential_or_current and target-scoped directness gates.
secondary_readouts: Preservation of the all-NA, non-current transcript-context diagnostic with no ranking or Top.
Target-specific sensitivity rankings and source-log directness classifications.
Manifest validation and isolated replay of all generated outputs.
time_system: No new time-course analysis; no ZT/CT or LD/DD inference.
required_metadata: Candidate ID and scored summary fields, preserving NA distinctly from zero.
Source-log ID, checked source, assay, evidence label, target-cell scope and evidence_target_cells.
Requested target neuron group, selected readout domain, directness/shortlist gate, coverage and score status.
Synthetic invalid-input case, expected rejection point, and whether a ranking output was created.
Manifest and isolated-replay status with output hashes.
analysis_plan: Validate the 15-row candidate table jointly against its 19-record checked search log. Run score_candidates.py independently for each requested target with readout_match=membrane_potential_or_current. Exercise missing-log, all-NA-current, and candidate-summary/source-log mismatch cases synthetically and require failure before output creation. Preserve a GSE157504 all-NA non-current no-log diagnostic as a negative control. Validate and isolated-replay the public-data manifest. Conduct a separate blind forward test from the skill instructions and raw evidence inputs without consulting historical task reports.
decision_gate: Verify only if candidate/log validation passes; scored/current tables cannot be ranked without the paired log and readout; a source-log mismatch is rejected before writing scores; the all-NA transcript diagnostic has no ranked candidates or Top; target-specific results respect directness gates; the full test suite and isolated manifest replay pass.
acceptance_tests: The candidate table validates as 15 candidates and its checked search log as 19 records with zero schema/linkage issues.
Scored evidence, including non-current scored GSE context, cannot be ranked without --search-log and --readout-match; current all-NA tables cannot use the exception.
The scorer jointly revalidates the candidate table against the supplied log and rejects a deliberately misleading Irk1 summary before creating output.
The all-NA GSE157504 non-current diagnostic remains unranked, with empty rankings and no Top.
Native-current evidence gates return Shaw/Shal for s-LNv, na/Shaw/Shal for l-LNv, and no direct Top for LNd or broad DN; Irk1 remains needs_direct_evidence for s-/l-LNv native current.
Independent blind forward test reproduces the four target outcomes and identifies raw-ranking versus gate-qualified Top interpretation explicitly.
The public-data manifest validates and isolated replay reproduces all declared run outputs; the complete unittest suite passes.

verification.candidate_and_log_validation: verified_candidate_evidence_table; 15 candidates; 19 source-log records; zero issues.
verification.synthetic_fail_closed_tests: 5 new regression cases cover omitted logs, current all-NA input, candidate/log inconsistency before output, and the narrow all-NA diagnostic exception.

real_target_results.s-LNv: Shaw and Shal pass the native-current evidence gate as a tied Top set; no unique winner.
real_target_results.l-LNv: na is the unique evidence-score Top; Shaw and Shal also pass the directness gate.

verification.Irk1_interpretation: The checked S2-R+ culture patch-clamp record is not native clock-neuron current; s-LNv ClopHensor measures intracellular chloride; period/genetic and expression/localization records are different readouts. Irk1 is needs_direct_evidence for s-/l-LNv native current.
verification.transcript_negative_control: GSE157504 all-NA diagnostic reports insufficient_scored_evidence with empty rankings and no Top.
verification.independent_blind_forward_test: Separate evaluator used the current skill and raw candidate/log inputs, without historical reports. It independently reproduced s-LNv Shaw/Shal tie, l-LNv na with Shaw/Shal also passing, no LNd/broad-DN Top, and Irk1 exclusion; it noted DN1p-only na evidence is partial coverage, not broad-DN support.
verification.isolated_replay: verified_public_dataset_replay; 6 runs; 11 output hashes reproduced; zero issues.
verification.related_manifest_chains: GSE157504 context overlay, GSE157504 evidence bridge, and combined transcript context manifests and isolated replays revalidated after scorer changes.
verification.interpretation: Curated evidence triage and tool-behavior validation only; not biological proof or candidate-specific causal evidence.

limitations: Source-log schema and linkage validation do not independently prove that each paper supports its recorded claim; this iteration did not freshly audit every full text.
Scores and shortlist gates prioritize evidence review; they do not establish ion-channel causality or predict outcomes of native patch clamp.
The blind forward test was independently executed against the current local evidence files but did not perform a new web/full-text audit.

Formal electrophysiology design still requires user-specified sex, age, temperature, lighting history/time system, cell-identification method, biological-unit/power basis, reagent identity/specificity, and QC/exclusion criteria.
The scorer CSV contains the full ranked longlist, which may include gate-failing candidates; only the gate-qualified Top fields in the sensitivity JSON should be described as eligible Top results.
